problem_type: Explicit continuation loses interrupted prose at provider context conversion
symptom: The real Continue button sends a new request with user input 继续 but the model cannot see the stopped partial that remains visible and durable.
direct_cause: pi intentionally excludes aborted assistant messages from buildSessionContext and provider transformMessages; resume only drives an active operation.
class_root: Nomi did not represent its explicit Continue intent as a reference to authoritative stopped prose at its custom input boundary.
affected_population: Live and cold Continue actions across all provider protocols
Interrupted cards earlier in the current branch
Invalid, foreign and non-aborted continuation references
entry_points: Host prompt and queued input admission
Live and cold interrupted card Continue

external_sources.purpose: Installed source filters aborted messages before the official toProviderMessages extension; no partial continuation option.
Installed source intentionally rejects incomplete assistant reasoning/tool calls on replay.

invariants: Continue retains the exact user input and original aborted assistant entry; only its SDK entry reference is added to nomi.input context.
Admission validates a current-branch aborted text entry; request conversion resolves the same Session entry and includes text only as quoted user context.
Ordinary input does not implicitly continue; reasoning and unexecuted tool calls never enter the continuation context.
generality_proof: All desktop input converges on Host admission and the provider-neutral custom input conversion. Explicit entry identity selects the actual card across cold reload and older interrupted cards, independently of locale or protocol.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate a reference target and derive only stopped prose from the official Session entry.
Reject references outside the current branch before durable input admission.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: prompt, steer and follow-up input capture
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Every custom input validates its reference against the current SDK branch snapshot before admission.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: toProviderMessages on live and restored custom inputs
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Same Session.getEntry resolves durable prose and excludes tools/thinking for every configured protocol.

recurrence.reason: Every stopped assistant is deliberately omitted by the SDK, independent of caller, user wording or provider.
same_class_scan: Inspected installed pi session/context and pi-ai transformMessages filtering plus public resume active-operation contract.
Traced Shell Continue, actions.send, strict context parser, custom input capture and provider conversion.
Compared ordinary prompt, queued inputs and cold history reuse.

prevention.invariant: Continuation references only current-branch aborted prose and never reclassifies incomplete assistant history.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid or non-aborted references fail before admission; request conversion refuses missing/invalid durable targets.
prevention.strategy: Carry an explicit SDK entry ID through the existing input context and resolve it using the public Session API; quote text only in provider user context.

legacy_paths.rationale: No old runtime or transcript path is introduced or retained; the current custom-message extension gains a reference.

dependency_lifecycle.target: Supported pi version with public session context and aborted continuation contracts
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Filtering incomplete native messages is correct. Nomi explicit Continue adds quoted prose through the supported input extension.
exit_criteria: Reverify official aborted filtering and current public continuation API when upgrading pi; retain the text-only, original-entry and raw-input assertions.

migration: No history rewrite or migration. Older inputs have no continuation intent and remain unchanged.
residual_risks: Runner owns real Electron Stop/Continue/cold proof after the parent rebuild.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The Nomi custom input boundary can resolve authoritative stopped prose without changing the SDK transcript.
